current_tip_metadata_checks.method: Read-only GitHub branch metadata, complete recursive Git tree metadata grouped by tree OID, and HEAD requests to Contents endpoints pinned to exact commit IDs. No Git blobs, source text, images or media fetched; no repository or deployment mutations.
current_tip_metadata_checks.scope: Current branch tips only. Metadata verifies presence or absence of named paths and known capture directories. This does not clear history, other refs, live deployments, unrecognized inline content or licensing.
current_tip_metadata_checks.priority_file_basis: Five original Lexington project index.html entrypoints, confirmed in retained historical tree metadata. Entire templates/premium subtree is independently checked.

method.removed_and_legacy_requests: HEAD only, no response bodies read
method.approved_content_requests: GET only for current cleared source, compiled assets, notices and root; exact SHA-256 compared to local _site
method.cache: Ordinary canonical URLs, no cache purge or cache-busting query strings
method.limits: Status403 is blocked, never proof of removal. Exact body hashes establish served bytes at check time, not legal compliance or historical erasure.
method.html_hash_vantage: 94 HTML responses rechecked using ordinary default curl after alternate user-agent responses were transformed by the hosting proxy. Initial metadata retained separately; no hash normalization counted as success.
method.email_host_transformation: 34 raw HTML responses remain byte-different. Only bounded documented provider email rewrites are reversed for a separate exact-origin comparison; no raw hash is relabeled as matching.

hosting_transform_observations.description: Two private cleared-page diffs identified a367-byte hosting-injected module script before the body closing tag, with current deployment Last-Modified timestamps. Exact default-curl checks provide separate unchanged-byte evidence.

initial_browser_profile_observations.limit: Raw mismatches were preserved and not treated as byte-identical source. Subsequent precise origin comparisons and provider-transformation evidence are recorded separately.

analytics_samples.method: Private diffs for two current cleared pages. Only the identified complete hosting-injected script block was removed diagnostically; direct curl comparisons remain the strict byte verification. No raw script content, identifiers or page bodies are included in this report.

email_response_verification.method: Reverse only provider-protected mailto hrefs and exact protected-email spans after decoding. Every protected href must match a unique local source anchor with identical decoded attribute names, values and, when needed to disambiguate, unchanged inner text; only provider-rewritten quoting, empty-attribute syntax and whitespace may be restored. Exact provider wrappers around plain email text may be reversed only when decoded text is present in local source. Remove only one known empty external email decoder script and at most one known empty external analytics script. Entire resulting bytes must match local publication exactly. No generic DOM or whitespace normalization. Raw served SHA mismatches remain separate.
